description: Phase 6+3.9+3.10: Notification integration, home feed exclusion of group posts, and status visibility enforcement. Wires notifications into services, excludes group posts from home feed/search, and enforces visibility in StatusPolicy.
steps: Modify app/services/join_occm_group_service.rb - when approval_required and membership created as pending, call NotifyOccmGroupService for each admin/moderator member with type :occm_group_join_request
Modify app/services/approve_occm_group_member_service.rb - after approving, call NotifyOccmGroupService for the requester with type :occm_group_join_approved
Modify app/services/reject_occm_group_member_service.rb - after rejecting, call NotifyOccmGroupService for the requester with type :occm_group_join_rejected
Modify app/services/delete_occm_group_status_service.rb - after deleting, call NotifyOccmGroupService for the post author with type :occm_group_post_deleted

Add scope to Status model or the OccmGroupVisibility concern: scope :excluding_occm_group_posts that uses WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM occm_group_statuses WHERE occm_group_statuses.status_id = statuses.id) pattern for efficient filtering

Modify app/services/fan_out_on_write_service.rb - add a check at the beginning of the perform method (or relevant entry point): return early / skip home feed fanout if the status has an associated occm_group_status record (check OccmGroupStatus.exists?(status_id: @status.id))

Modify app/controllers/api/v1/accounts/statuses_controller.rb (or the relevant scope) - apply excluding_occm_group_posts scope to exclude group posts from account timeline API responses unless the viewer is a group member

Modify app/policies/status_policy.rb - in the show? method (or equivalent visibility check), add a condition: if the status has limited visibility AND has an occm_group_status record, check that the viewing account has active membership in that group. Return false if not a member

Ensure GET /api/v1/statuses/:id returns 404 (not 403) for non-members viewing a group post - this may already be handled by StatusPolicy returning false which triggers RecordNotFound, but verify and adjust if needed
acceptance_criteria: Join request sends notification to all admin + moderator members when approval_required is true
Approve sends occm_group_join_approved notification to the requesting user
Reject sends occm_group_join_rejected notification to the requesting user
Post delete sends occm_group_post_deleted notification to the post author
Group posts do not appear in home timeline feed (FanOutOnWriteService skips them)
Group posts do not appear in account timeline API for non-members
StatusPolicy#show? returns false for group posts when viewer is not an active member
GET /api/v1/statuses/:id returns 404 for group posts viewed by non-members
The excluding_occm_group_posts scope uses efficient SQL (NOT EXISTS or LEFT JOIN IS NULL)
verification: Run: ruby -c on all modified Ruby files to verify syntax
Verify the fan_out_on_write_service change does not break non-group statuses
